response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), g AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_of_avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM p, g WHERE p.ratio > g.avg_ratio
